name: ecp
description: Run your ECP (Epic Control Panel) hosting account from chat: launch WordPress or app sites, connect domains and HTTPS, manage databases, files and backups, and fix problems, with no server knowledge needed.

panel_url.title: ECP panel address
panel_url.description: The address you open to log into ECP, e.g. https://example.com:2323 (just example.com works too).

username.title: ECP username
username.description: The username you log into ECP with.

password.title: ECP password
password.description: The password you log into ECP with. Kept in your system's secure storage.
